name: Cetyl isononanoate
description: Cetyl isononanoate (CAS 84878-33-1 ), also known as hexadecyl isononanoate, is a synthetic ester derived from cetyl alcohol and isononanoic acid. It functions as an emollient, skin-conditioning agent, and lubricant across personal care and industrial formulations. Its low viscosity and excellent spreading characteristics make it a preferred carrier and texture modifier in finished products. In skincare and cosmetics, it is used in creams, lotions, sunscreens, and color cosmetics to improve skin feel. The material helps reduce greasiness and enhance active ingredient delivery. Hair care formulators incorporate it into conditioners and styling products where it provides slip and detangling without heavy buildup. In lubricant and metalworking applications, it serves as a base fluid or co-solvent in light-duty lubricants and release agents. It is particularly useful where low residue and good surface wetting are required for the application. Coatings and adhesive formulators use it as a plasticizing solvent to improve flexibility and substrate compatibility. This versatility makes it a staple ingredient for manufacturers across multiple chemical sectors. Cetyl isononanoate is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade specifications meeting the standards expected for personal care raw material sourcing, ensuring high purity and performance. Technical-grade material is also offered for industrial end uses. Typical supply formats include drums and IBC totes for bulk procurement, catering to large-scale manufacturing requirements and logistics needs.
